notes.title: WHNBSMF: Rotate Camera Fix (26/03/2024)
notes.notes:
This patch adds a fix so that the camera can now be rotated around the player.

This is particularly useful on FM_03 where the nature of the map meant it was hard to see where the player was behind the cliff faces.

Note: By default left and right shoulder buttons.

notes.title: WHNBSMF: Gamepad Control Fixes (March 24th 2024)
notes.notes:
This patch improves controller support. 

The players velocity is now accurately calculated based upon the cameras rotation. There is no longer a reduction in forward velocity as the player attempts to go forward into the floor. 

The Controller has been switched back to following the nav mesh, so the player should now have fewer instances where they end up out of intended play areas.

notes.title: WHNBSMF: Minor Control Fix + Camera
notes.notes:
Minor control fix to make it "feel" better moving around.
Fixed the Camera so it's at a set position form the player. This will be rotatable in a future patch.

notes.title: WHNBSMF: Player Controller Fixes
notes.notes: This patch fixes the player being able to fly towards the camera when running backwards and fixes player rotation so that it rotates in relation to the cameras orientation.

notes.title: WHNBSMF: Alpha Controller Support
notes.notes:
This release begins to add controller support, based off an XBOX 360 controller. Mouse control is currently no longer working. But this is a test to see if the control scheme can work on steam deck. 

Automated detection of controller vs Keyboard&Mouse will come in a future update.
